title: Divine Mercy: Eternal Father
text: Eternal Father, I offer you the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of Your dearly beloved Son, Our Lord Jesus Christ in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.
attribution: Chaplet of Divine Mercy (St. Faustina Kowalska)
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).

translation.latin: Pater aeterne, offero tibi Corpus et Sanguinem, Animam et Divinitatem dilectissimi Filii Tui, Domini nostri Iesu Christi, in propitiatione peccatorum nostrorum et totius mundi.
